VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The agent's self-report alone is insufficient to verify acceptance criteria compliance. While the agent claims to have fixed the issue and run 31 tests successfully, there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test results, code diff, or other artifacts) to corroborate these claims. The acceptance criteria explicitly requires "all 31 tests pass," which demands verifiable proof, not just assertion. Self-reports are the weakest form of evidence and cannot substitute for objective test results or code review artifacts.
